id: \bYou shouldn't have come down here. This place is sacred.
en: \bYou shouldn't have come down here. This place is sacred.
it: \bNon saresti dovuto venire quaggiù. Questo luogo è sacro.
\bStai alla larga da qui e basta.

id: \bSophocles: So what did you think? Pretty cool place, isn't it?
en: \bSophocles: So what did you think? Pretty cool place, isn't it?
it: \bChrys: Allora, che ne pensi? Posto fico, eh?

id: \bI'm impressed that you even made it this far. I guess we can battle now; I hear you're into that kind of thing. I'll heal your team first though.
en: \bI'm impressed that you even made it this far. I guess we can battle now; I hear you're into that kind of thing. I'll heal your team first though.
it: \bSono colpito che tu sia arrivato fin qui. Immagino che ora possiamo lottare; ho sentito che ti piacciono queste cose. Prima però curo la tua squadra.

id: \bSophocles: I guess you had some good luck. Are you ready to go back?
en: \bSophocles: I guess you had some good luck. Are you ready to go back?
it: \bChrys: Direi che hai avuto un bel colpo di fortuna. Sei pronto a tornare?

id: \bI have some bugs to work out.
en: \bI have some bugs to work out.

id: \bI could go for a practice dummy.
en: \bI could go for a practice dummy.
it: \bMi servirebbe proprio un manichino per allenarmi.
